what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 42857 Iranian refugees in the United Kingdom, 27.1% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany and the United Kingdom host the most Iranian refugees, followed by Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Iraq from 1983 to 1988, at war level in every year.

It also records armed conflict over the government of Iran in many years, most recently with Jaish al-Adl from 2023 to 2025, and an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 8159 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
